scientific_integrity: Analytic finite-bound proof plus reproducible exact finite checks. No empirical finite check is represented as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform feasible-edge sampling, equal dense parts, and \(n\ge16k\); quantitative approximation need not be rate-optimal. Prior art unavailable in complete text for selected older sources; priority is qualified.
title: A binomial obstruction to random greedy matching under a rare tripartite perturbation
